consumer: An engine LOS condition such as Character::sees(target) / a targeting/ranged-eligibility or NPC-visibility check that asks 'does the avatar have a clear line of sight to this tile right now?' and EVALUATES the boolean it computes.
scope: A map-region reachability from the avatar's current tile to the given target tile within sight range (from-tile-to-target LOS), not carried items and not a whole-map dump.
decisive_source: src/map.cpp::map::sees(F,T,range) — body delegates to the four-arg sees overload and returns the engine-computed reachability boolean between the two tripoints within range; pl_sees/write_tiles is only the display proxy.
divergence: A target tile in clear, unobstructed line of sight within range that has never been drawn/remembered: the display 'seen'/pl_sees value reports false (display lag, and headlessly always false) while the true LOS predicate map::sees returns true — exposing the D display-proxy as the wrong authority.
